LL.label: double long
LL.notes: found in Dahlsberg khipu; appears something like a long knot with two axes.  Aschers give it a value of 3.

BL.label: belted long knot
BL.notes: found on UR035; long knot with an extra wrap around the outside

H.label: overhand knot
H.notes: overhand knot attachment; did't use o because of confusion with zero

T.label: top cord
T.notes: cord hangs opposite to the pendants

C.label: cut
C.notes: cord has been cut (sharper end than broken)

K.label: knotted
K.notes: cord ends with a knot near the bottom

D.label: doubled
D.notes: end of cord is doubled over

U.label: unfinished
U.notes: not knotted; not broken; not cut... just ends

TT.label: canutito
TT.notes: end of cord is wrapped with colored thread

AH.label: animal hair
AH.notes: as described by Aschers; don't know what kind of animal

-.label: barber pole
-.notes: ascher code for two components of different colors twisted together

:.label: mottled
:.notes: components are spun from more than one color, resulting in an irregular mottled appearance

*_.label: special operator
*_.notes: see databooks.  found on dahslberg khipu

/.label: splice
/.notes: colour changes along the cord; ranges in cm

100.label: Leymebamba
100.notes: Khipu from the Chachapoyas area discovered at Laguna de los Condores

201.label: Circum-Ica
201.notes: Khipu with provenance from places close to Ica: between Ica and Pisco, Ocucaje, Ullujalla y Callengo

300.label: Pachacamac
300.notes: Khipu with provenance listed as Pachacamac

202.label: Nazca
202.notes: Khipu with provenance stated as Nazca.

301.label: Puruchuco
301.notes: khipu found at the site of Puruchuco

S.label: S-plied
S.notes: final ply twist leans like the middle of an S

Z.label: Z-plied
Z.notes: final ply twist leans like the middle of a Z

S.label: S
S.notes: knot tied with an S slant

Z.label: Z
Z.notes: knot tied with a Z slant
